grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.description: Using the Grapple costs 0 AP and can propel this soldier up to 15 tiles. Grants immunity to reaction fire during use. Single use only.

advanced-grapple.name: Advanced Grapple
advanced-grapple.description: Using the Grapple costs 0 AP and can propel this soldier up to 15 tiles. Grants immunity to reaction fire during use. 3 uses.

damage-control.name: Damage Control
damage-control.description: Grants +5% DR each time damage is received. If at full HP, grants +50 crit resist. If shredded, reduce shred to a maximum of 50% at end of turn.

repulsor.name: Repulsor
repulsor.description: If at full HP, non-psionic attacks are repulsed, causing them to graze (dealing only half of the original damage).

sealed.name: Sealed
sealed.description: Internal air supply and oxygen recycling systems grant the wearer immunity to strangulation.

flame-resistant.name: Flame Resistant
flame-resistant.description: Internal vapor chambers with intergrated cooling systems grant this unit with complete immunity to fire hazards.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.description: Activate to turn invisible until your next action or next turn (2-turn cooldown). Cannot Ghost while Holo-Targeted. Attacks made while Ghosted gain +30 crit.

psi-boost.name: Psi Boost
psi-boost.description: Infuses explosives to deal 1 bonus psionic damage. Increases Kinetic Blast and Rift damage by 2.

advanced-psi-boost.name: Advanced Psi Boost
advanced-psi-boost.description: Infuses explosives to deal 2 bonus psionic damage. Increases Kinetic Blast and Rift damage by 4.

steady-weapon.name: Steady Weapon
steady-weapon.description: Shots do not graze, bypass half of impenetrable cover, gain double base aim, +15 pen, and reaction fire immunity. Rocket range +20%, scatter -75%. Lost if unit acts, is hit, or swaps weapons. Steadying does not trigger reaction fire.

aerial-precision.name: Aerial Precision
aerial-precision.description: Grants +20 crit and +50% crit damage against airborne targets.

burst.name: Burst
burst.description: Fire a +20 aim shot. Requires 2 ammo.

volume-fire.name: Volume Fire
volume-fire.description: High fire volume grants +75% base damage vs exposed, pincered, or point-blank enemies, reduces enemy graze chance by 25, and increases distortion maluses by 50%.

hip-fire.name: Hip Fire
hip-fire.description: Accuracy gains on standard shots above 70% hit chance only contribute half to final hit chance, except on consecutive shots at the same target.

bulletstorm.name: Bulletstorm
bulletstorm.description: Spray fire across a 30 degree cone out to 18 tiles. Every enemy in the cone has 2x 24% chances (12% with an LMG) to take Standard Shot Damage. Requires 2 ammo.

shredder.name: Shredder
shredder.description: Primary weapon attacks apply Shred equal to the damage dealt as a percent of the target's max HP (which increases subsequent damage the target receives by the amount of Shred) for the remainder of the battle.

danger-zone.name: Danger Zone
danger-zone.description: Suppression affects (with half suppressive fire damage) targets in a 2.5 tile radius around the primary target.

maim.name: Maim
maim.description: Fire 2 shots with an aim malus of -5 per HP of the target. The shots deal 1 damage each. Any damage against a biological target with 1 HP will Maim the target instead of dealing damage, preventing the target from performing reactive fire and skipping it's next turn.

light-volume-fire.name: Light Volume Fire
light-volume-fire.description: High fire volume grants +50% base damage vs exposed, pincered, or point-blank enemies and reduces enemy graze chance by 15.

overload.name: Overload
overload.description: Standard shots against mechanical units clear overwatch and reactive targeting sensors and have a chance to disorient targets equal to the percent of max HP they lost. Triple the chance vs SHIVs.

stun.name: Stun
stun.description: Non-lethal, short-range arc attack that has a chance to stun biological targets. Any target at or below 4 HP that resists the stun will be maimed instead. Stun chance increases if target is at low HP.

ether-shredder.name: Ether Shredder
ether-shredder.description: Primary weapon attacks apply Shred equal to the damage dealt as a percent of the target's max HP (which increases subsequent damage the target receives by the amount of Shred) to any unit with distortion for the remainder of the battle.

sublimator.name: Sublimator
sublimator.description: Grants +10 penetration vs hardened targets and deals triple damage to Plasma Shields.

panzer-shredder.name: Panzer Shredder
panzer-shredder.description: Primary weapon attacks apply Shred equal to the damage dealt as a percent of the target's max HP (which increases subsequent damage the target receives by the amount of Shred) to any grounded mechanical unit for the remainder of the battle.

aerial-shredder.name: Aerial Shredder
aerial-shredder.description: Primary weapon attacks apply Shred equal to the damage dealt as a percent of the target's max HP (which increases subsequent damage the target receives by the amount of Shred) to any flying-capable unit for the remainder of the battle.

aerial-tracking.name: Aerial Tracking
aerial-tracking.description: Shots from the primary weapon ignore the 30 defense bonus flying targets receive.

carapace-shredder.name: Carapace Shredder
carapace-shredder.description: Primary weapon attacks apply Shred equal to the damage dealt as a percent of the target's max HP (which increases subsequent damage the target receives by the amount of Shred) to any hardened biologic unit for the remainder of the battle.

prototype-rigging.name: Prototype Rigging
prototype-rigging.description: +1 utility slot. Does not gain extra effects from Tactical Rigging.

gear-mounts.name: Gear Mounts
gear-mounts.description: The last two utility slots on this armor can only hold passive gear, such as plating, scopes, ammo, and mags.

gear-mount.name: Gear Mount
gear-mount.description: The last utility slot on this armor can only hold passive gear, such as plating, scopes, ammo, and mags.

psi-mount.name: Psi Mount
psi-mount.description: The last utility slot on this armor can only hold passive psi gear: the Conduit, Neural Scope, Psi Defender, Psi Frayer or Neuroregulator.

hardened.name: Hardened
hardened.description: This unit cannot be exposed and gains +35% DR.

body-shield.name: Body Shield
body-shield.description: Grants a 30% chance for incoming shots to graze, dealing half their original damage. The nearest visible enemy suffers -20 aim against this unit and cannot critically hit it.

concussive-blast.name: Concussive Blast
concussive-blast.description: Damaging an enemy clears their overwatch and has a chance to disorient them equal to the percent of max base HP they lost from this attack.

explosive-shredder.name: Explosive Shredder
explosive-shredder.description: Applies Shred equal to 2x the damage dealt as a percent of the target's max HP (which increases subsequent damage the target receives by the amount of Shred).

disorient.name: Disorient
disorient.description: Cancels overwatch and suppression, -10 defense, -30 will, -60 aim, -60% ability range, -60% mobility, -60% melee damage, +60% scatter. Lasts 1 turn.

in-smoke.name: In Smoke
in-smoke.description: Units in the area of effect gain In Smoke [-10 aim, +30 def, prevents extra crit from exposed, and does not trigger reaction shots -- aim/def affects psi as well]. Lasts through 1 enemy turn.

corroded.name: Corroded
corroded.description: Disables passive healing, reduces base DR by half, strips 2 + 10% of armor HP at start of turn, -20 aim, -20% mobility, and -20% range for AoE attacks; lasts 3 turns. The acid can be removed by a Medikit.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.description: A single target within the AoE is cleansed of holo and is temporarily Shadowed (rendering them invisible to the enemy) until the start of their next turn. Performing any action removes the shadow. Attacking while shadowed provides +30% critical hit chance. Does not affect this unit, units capable of flight, hidden units, panicking units, units in One For All, or units in Ghost Armor.

heal.name: Heal
heal.description: Use a Medikit to heal 4 missing HP and remove corrosion on a biosoldier.

stabilize.name: Stabilize
stabilize.description: Prevent a critically wounded biosoldier or MEC from bleeding out.

stimmed.name: Stimmed
stimmed.description: +2 regeneration, +2.0 mobility, +20 aim, +20 will, and immunity to fatigued/exhausted for 4 turns.

corrosion-resistance.name: Corrosion Resistance
corrosion-resistance.description: Corrosion only lasts a single turn.

squadsight.name: Squadsight
squadsight.description: Allows firing with long-range weapons around some obstacles and beyond 18 tiles at targets with a spotter (a unconcealed ally at 0 AP that can see the target). Grants +2 aim per ally (+8 per scout) that can see the target and -5 aim for each tile beyond 18.Does not apply to overwatch or reaction shots.

shadowstep.name: Shadowstep
shadowstep.description: This unit gains +0.6 mobility and does not trigger reaction shots or pursuit when walking (not dashing). After repositioning, shots gain +25% crit damage until next turn.

platform-stability.name: Platform Stability
platform-stability.description: If this soldier is on the ground and has not moved, they gain: +15 aim, -80% rocket scatter, and +1 damage to suppressive fire. Prevents damage from breaking a steadied weapon. Allows steadying of SAWs and LMGs.

breach.name: Breach
breach.description: Against targets within 4 tiles, the primary weapon deals +1 damage and its shots do not graze.

shred-resistance.name: Shred Resistance
shred-resistance.description: Applications of shred on this unit have a quarter the effect.

tracker.name: Tracker
tracker.description: This unit passively uncloaks seekers within 6 tiles through walls/obstacles. Provides immunity to strangulation.

unphased-mobility.name: Unphased Mobility
unphased-mobility.description: Sets unit mobility to 9.3 and ignores all mobility modifying effects.

psiscopic-vision.name: Psiscopic Vision
psiscopic-vision.description: Grants +15 aim to non-reaction shots if a psionic ally can also see the target.

conduit.name: Conduit
conduit.description: Provides a will/4% (max 25%) chance for all end-in-idle actions to cost 0 AP.

holo-sync.name: Holo Sync
holo-sync.description: Non-reaction shots gain 2x the bonus from Holo (3x if this unit has Holo Rounds).

incineration.name: Incineration
incineration.description: Flamethrowers apply 10 shred to any target they damage.

sprinter.name: Sprinter
sprinter.description: Grants +1.3 mobility and +10 defense. Doubles damage from Ram.

psionic-resistance.name: Psionic Resistance
psionic-resistance.description: Decreases the mind fray/rend damage dealt to this unit by 50%. If this unit panics, it only lasts a single turn. This unit's actions will not trigger countercharge.

awareness.name: Awareness
awareness.description: A state of constant alertness grants this unit +20 defense at all times.

cognitive-enhancement.name: Cognitive Enchancement
cognitive-enhancement.description: Provides a 10% chance for all end-in-idle actions to cost 0 AP.

flak.name: Flak
flak.description: Shots from the primary weapon ignore half of the 30 defense bonus flying targets receive. Non-reaction standard shots from the primary weapon deal 1 damage to all flying units within 4 tiles of the primary target.

gravity-well.name: Gravity Well
gravity-well.description: Affects all units within 4 tiles of the mine reducing their defense by 10. Any unit that starts their turn in the gravity well will take damage that bypasses DR equal to 10% of their current HP.

mist.name: Mist
mist.description: Heals all units within 2 tiles of this unit for 5 HP.
